source: Tracker draft. That draft says the figures are from the Apify API at the asOf time. actors.md was not in this repo.

actors.name: uk-public-tenders-feed
actors.title: UK Tenders Scraper & API: Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, TED
actors.what: Pulls new UK public-sector tenders and contract awards from Find a Tender, Contracts Finder and EU TED into one dataset.

actors.name: uk-visa-sponsor-register-monitor
actors.title: UK Visa Sponsor Register Scraper & Monitor (Home Office)
actors.what: Watches the Home Office licensed sponsor register and reports employers added, removed or downgraded since the last run.
actors.pricing: Sponsor change $0.01; Snapshot row $0.001; Companies House enriched row $0.004

actors.name: ebay-uk-listings-prices
actors.title: eBay UK Listings & Price Comps (GBP)
actors.what: Lists live ebay.co.uk listings for a keyword with £ prices and a median/range price-comp summary.

actors.name: gtrends-proxy-test
actors.title: Google Trends proxy-cost probe (internal prototype)
actors.what: Internal test measuring Google Trends success rate and proxy cost; not meant for the Store.

actors.name: uk-google-trends
actors.title: Google Trends Scraper UK: Interest, Regions & Related Queries
actors.what: Fetches Google Trends interest over time, by UK region and related queries for up to 5 keywords.

actors.name: uk-companies-house-feed
actors.title: UK Companies House Scraper: New Companies Feed & Alerts
actors.what: Daily feed of newly incorporated UK companies plus liquidation and dissolution alerts from Companies House.

actors.name: uk-fca-short-positions
actors.title: FCA Short Positions Scraper: UK Short Interest Tracker
actors.what: Tracks UK short interest from the FCA net short positions report, with daily change alerts.

actors.name: uk-political-donations
actors.title: UK Political Donations Scraper: Electoral Commission API
actors.what: Searches Electoral Commission donations and loans to UK parties and politicians, and flags new ones.

actors.name: uk-bnpl-merchant-detector
actors.title: BNPL Checker UK: Klarna, Clearpay & PayPal Pay in 3 Detector
actors.what: Checks UK online shops for Klarna, Clearpay, PayPal Pay in 3 and other buy-now-pay-later options and their platform.

actors.name: uk-food-hygiene-ratings
actors.title: UK Food Hygiene Ratings Scraper & New Restaurant Leads
actors.what: Searches FSA food hygiene ratings and flags newly listed food businesses and rating changes.
actors.pricing: Establishment row $0.002; New business lead $0.005; Rating change $0.01

actors.name: uk-gazette-insolvency-notices
actors.title: UK Insolvency Notices Scraper: Gazette Winding-Up Feed
actors.what: Daily feed of UK winding-up petitions, administrations and liquidations from The Gazette.

actors.name: uk-product-safety-recalls
actors.title: UK Product Recalls Scraper: OPSS, FSA & MHRA Safety Alerts
actors.what: Combines OPSS product recalls, FSA food alerts and MHRA medicine and device alerts in one feed.

actors.name: amazon-uk-bestsellers
actors.title: Amazon UK Best Sellers, Movers & Shakers & New Releases Tracker
actors.what: Scrapes Amazon UK Best Sellers, Movers & Shakers and New Releases lists and flags rank changes.

actors.name: uk-ofgem-price-cap
actors.title: UK Ofgem Energy Price Cap: Rates by Region + Forecast
actors.what: Returns official Ofgem energy price cap rates and standing charges for every GB region, with optional forecasts.

actors.name: uk-jobs-feed
actors.title: UK Jobs Feed: NHS Jobs, DWP Find a Job & Company Careers Pages
actors.what: One de-duplicated UK jobs feed from NHS Jobs, DWP Find a Job and Greenhouse, Lever and Workable boards.

actors.name: uk-planning-applications
actors.title: UK Planning Applications Scraper: Council Planning Data & Leads
actors.what: Collects new UK planning applications from council portals, filterable by council, date and keyword.
actors.pricing: Planning application row $0.003; New planning application $0.008

actors.name: uk-nhs-prescribing-data
actors.title: UK NHS Prescribing Data: GP Drug Trends for All 4 Nations
actors.what: Monthly GP prescribing figures for any drug across all four UK nations, with biggest movers.
actors.pricing: Actor Start $0.02; Trend row $0.002; Mover alert $0.01

actors.name: biotech-catalyst-tracker
actors.title: Biotech Catalyst Tracker: FDA & MHRA Approvals, Trials, AdComs
actors.what: Feed of FDA and MHRA approvals, FDA rejections, advisory meetings and clinical-trial changes from official sources.
